_note: The 20 'no meta' test teams of combat v2 (Nathan 2026-10-18: every team strong in its own way). Card keys only (public card data, no member data). hunt = 8 cards, dungeon = 5 cards (also the Gauntlet squad). counters = the mechanics that the design expects to cut the team. casual = built mostly from common cards (no Full Art or Gold finish). Run: node card-studio/v2sim/run.mjs teams

teams.name: Venom Garden
teams.theme: A toxic greenhouse: Noobeth's Venusaur and the swamp plants feed on a poisoned target.
plan: Stack Poison to 3 for a Toxic burst, again and again, on one big target.
The payoffs (Toxic Bloom, Stack Up, Rally Cap) hit hardest while the target is Poisoned.
teams.strengths: Hunt (Poison and bursts use the boss reference HP), big single foes, Guard and Bulwark (ticks ignore shields).

teams.name: Bowser's Kitchen
teams.theme: Two Bowsers, a Talonflame and a hot pizza: everything is on fire, and FRICK blows it up.
plan: Keep Burn stacks on the target with fire riders and Wrong Way, then Detonate them with FRICK.
Burn halves enemy heals, so it beats healing bosses and Regrowth.
teams.strengths: Healing enemies (Regrowth, drain, regenerate), hordes (Fire Breath spreads Burn).

teams.name: Permafrost
teams.theme: Polar Bear Build and the water squad freeze the enemy, then Donkey Kong punches the ice.
plan: Stack Chill to 3 to Freeze the enemy (it skips a turn).
Giant Punch deals x2 to a Frozen target and more per Chill stack.
teams.strengths: Enraged and Cataclysm bosses (a Freeze cancels a Charging turn), Dungeon elites and hordes (Hydro Cannon Chills every foe).

teams.name: Static Shock
teams.theme: Three electric mice and a bounty hunter: the enemy is Paralyzed and every second action fails.
plan: Paralyze the enemy with Thunderbolt, Thunder Jolt, Lag Spike and Communication Error.
Glass Cannon and Rapid Fire cash in on the Paralyzed target.
teams.strengths: Dungeon fights with few hard-hitting foes (Paralyzed skips half of their actions), crit-friendly content.

teams.name: Lights Out
teams.theme: Server pings, flash bangs and a dirt nap: the enemy is stunned or asleep, and Little Mac lands the KO.
plan: Chain Stun and Sleep so that the enemy loses turns (one shared control immunity limits it); Vioarr's Link adds a Stun on a crit.
KO Punch, Warlock Punch and Rest Confirm hit a helpless target harder; in the Dungeon, Quack wakes a stunned ally.
teams.strengths: Dungeon guardians and elites (control lasts longer than on the Hunt boss), Enraged and Charging enemies.

teams.name: Bounty Board
teams.theme: A Tag Check names the target, and every hunter in the room cashes the bounty.
plan: Mark the enemy every turn: the next hit cannot miss and deals more.
Blaster Ledge, B...B...B... and Settle This are the payoffs of the Mark.
teams.strengths: Evasive and Ironhide enemies (a Mark cannot miss and can crit an Ironhide), the Mythic boss.

teams.name: Open Season
teams.theme: Kroc Bot and The Dad Gaming crew pile onto a target that a tasty morsel left wide open.
plan: Expose the target with Look Out, The Right Way and Flash Bang: it takes more from every source.
Peaches Beam and TDG Crew deal extra damage to an Exposed target; in the Dungeon, Comeback heals and Empowers.
teams.strengths: Big-HP targets (Hunt boss, guardian), short Dungeon fights. Built from common cards.

teams.name: Bully Pulpit
teams.theme: TheChamp, Gym Rat Lion and Baego: the community crew bullies a weakened enemy, and HR takes their side.
plan: Weaken the enemy hard (Taunt 38%, Soup or Water, Flame Choke): it deals less and takes the payoffs.
Next Year, Chocolate Milk and Better Side hit a Weakened target harder, and the squad lives longer.
teams.strengths: Hard-hitting enemies (Weakened cuts their damage), long Dungeon runs. Built from common cards.

teams.name: Mind Games
teams.theme: Mew, Dodrio and Ness scramble the enemy's mind: confused enemies hit themselves.
plan: Confuse the enemy every turn (Wait a Minute, She's Here, Stupid Word): 30% of its attacks hit itself.
Triple Peck and PSI Magnet cash in on the Confused target.
teams.strengths: Single hard hitters (a confused boss hits itself), Dungeon fights. Built from common cards.

teams.name: Smoke and Mirrors
teams.theme: A bright mountain base, a hiding spot and a sun salute: the enemy cannot see, and Megaman clutches the shot.
plan: Blind the enemy so that a quarter of its attacks miss.
Doubles Clutch and Haunting Dive deal extra damage and crits to a Blinded target.
teams.strengths: Hard-hitting single foes (misses protect the squad), long fights.

teams.name: Slow Motion
teams.theme: Min Min, Umbreon and the Timezone Chart: the enemy is always late, and Waluigi has waited long enough.
plan: Slow the enemy (ARMS Reach, Moonlight, VC Greeting, The Plan): it acts less often.
Jet Hammer, Waited Long Enough and Taps the Sign hit a Slowed target harder.
teams.strengths: Fast enemies and the Hunt Cataclysm clock (fewer enemy turns in 40 steps).

teams.name: Royal Court
teams.theme: Long live the King: the heralds of the court Empower four champions for one huge hit each.
plan: Four Heralds Empower the four attackers again and again (+20% to +50% a hit).
Limit Break, Kingdom Key, MY SWAMP and ARMS Reach turn every boost into a big single hit.
teams.strengths: Armored and high-Defense enemies (big hits, Pierce), the Hunt boss.

teams.name: Critical Hit Club
teams.theme: Onyen's $150 lessons pay off: Link, Pikachu and Richter crit, and every crit adds a status.
plan: Focus the crit attackers (Suavemente, $150 an Hour, Coffee Break) toward the crit cap.
Each crit adds a rider: Stun (50/50), Paralyze (Thunderbolt), Blind (Blind Spot).
teams.strengths: Short rooms and the Dispeller boss (crit is not Empower), big-HP targets.

teams.name: Fortress
teams.theme: Two walls, a projectile wall and King K. Rool's swamp: the squad hides behind shields and hits back.
plan: Keep shields on everyone (Two Walls, Projectile Wall, Last One Alive) and self-shield on every hit.
Fever Pitch Quickens and Empowers a shielded hitter; MY SWAMP and Timber! break enemy shields.
teams.strengths: Long Dungeon runs, Cataclysm and heavy hits, Guard-using foes (Breakers).

teams.name: Field Hospital
teams.specialist_note: A designed specialist (Nathan 2026-10-19): its home is the casual Dungeon run. The approved Gauntlet fix removed its Gauntlet home, so check d (balanced) skips it. Checks a, b and c still apply.
teams.theme: A Discord pizza party, 120 shovels and a 24-hour stream: Zeoic hosts, the medics keep everyone alive.
plan: Five Medics heal every turn, so the three attackers never fall.
It wins the long fight: the most HP left at the end of a room and the deepest casual Dungeon runs.
teams.strengths: Long Dungeon runs and attrition foes (Venom, poison and drain). Built from common cards.

teams.name: Quick Draw
teams.theme: Enter Foxtrot and the 2-week game fever: the flurry squad acts before the enemy can blink.
plan: Quicken the Flurry attackers (Watch It Go Down, Fever Pitch, Automation, Express Run) for more actions in the same steps.
Many small strikes roll many riders (Burn, Chill, Weakened) and outrun enemy heals.
teams.strengths: Healing enemies (Regrowth, drain), the Hunt daily step cap (more actions in 40 steps).

teams.name: Spin to Win
teams.theme: Brego's Link spins, Incineroar hugs the room and the bowling ball takes every pin.
plan: Hit every foe at once: Cleaver basics splash 60%, the actives spread Exposed, Poison and Weakened.
Clear horde rooms fast and keep HP for the guardian.
teams.strengths: Horde rooms and many-foe fights, the Dungeon depth.

teams.name: Meme Warfare
teams.theme: Welcome to Meme Warfare: the weekly poll, a random pick and a colony of potato cannons pile every status on the target.
plan: Put many different statuses on one target (Confused, Blinded, Poison, Burn, Slowed, Exposed).
Meme Warfare, Feud and Potato Cannon grow with each different status (Pile On).
teams.strengths: Steadfast enemies (they need 3 different statuses), long single-target fights.

teams.name: Main Event
teams.theme: The Smash Bros main event: seven fighters and one cockroach that never dies, no time for defense.
plan: Seven attackers and one hype man (Never Die: Quicken and Empower the big hitter): the most raw damage of any team.
No healer and no wall, so it must win before the enemy grows.
teams.strengths: Short fights and the Gauntlet (base values only), the Hunt boss at low HP (Finisher lines).

teams.name: Party Games
teams.theme: Golf with friends, a bowling night and a grudge match: the party artillery never misses.
plan: Six supports, four of them Artillery: smites never miss and ignore the attack roll.
Two Finishers end the target when the shots bring it low.
teams.strengths: Evasive enemies and the Mythic boss (no miss), Dodge-type foes.
